headline: Never meditated?
subline: Free guided meditation, every day. No experience needed — just sit, breathe, and feel the difference in one session.

questions: What makes you feel most like yourself?
What are you ready to let go of?
When did you last feel truly rested?
Who would you be without the hurry?
What restores you — and how often do you allow it?

faqs.a: No. Every sit is guided from the first breath. Beginners and long-time practitioners sit together.

faqs.q: Is the daily program really free?
faqs.a: Yes — always. There is no fee, no upsell and no membership wall. We ask for nothing but a better world.

faqs.q: What if my mind keeps wandering?
faqs.a: That is the practice. Noticing the wander and gently returning is the whole exercise — not a failure of it.

faqs.q: Do I have to attend every day?
faqs.a: Come when you can. Daily is the invitation, not a rule; 41 consecutive days is simply where most people notice the change.

rituals.title: Make room for stillness
rituals.body: Give your thoughts a little space. Meditation is a practice of returning to the moment, one breath at a time.

rituals.title: Nourish with intention
rituals.body: Enjoy food that brings colour to your plate and care to your day. Slow down and savour what’s in front of you.

rituals.title: Get to know you
rituals.body: Notice what matters to you, what restores you, and what you’re ready to let go of. Curiosity is a lovely place to start.

eatingTips.text: Explore fresh vegetables, whole grains and foods you enjoy.
Put your phone aside and notice taste, texture and aroma.
Notice your hunger and fullness without rules or judgment.
